note.question: How can independent algorithms support algorithmic collusion: supra-competitive prices?
note.overview: The paper shows that the long-run prices from independent machine learning algorithms depend on the informational value of price experiments. If low, the long-run prices are consistent with the static Nash equilibrium; however, if high, the long-run prices are supra-competitive.
